import subprocess,sys,json
tests=[]
# emoji surrogate pair service, len counts as 1 codepoint
tests.append(json.dumps({"services":["\U0001F600"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["\U0001F600"]}}],"queries":[["\U0001F600"],["x"]]},ensure_ascii=True))
# but query "x" not in services -> should be E_SCHEMA. remove it
tests[-1]=json.dumps({"services":["\U0001F600"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["\U0001F600"]}}],"queries":[["\U0001F600"],[]]},ensure_ascii=True)
# 64 emoji ok
tests.append(json.dumps({"services":["\U0001F600"*64],"rules":[],"queries":[]}))
# 65 emoji -> E_LIMIT
tests.append(json.dumps({"services":["\U0001F600"*65],"rules":[],"queries":[]}))
# control char token newline and tab
tests.append(json.dumps({"services":["a\nb","c\t d","quot\""],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"endswith","path":["c\t d"]}}],"queries":[["a\nb","c\t d"],["quot\""]]}))
# raw invalid utf8 line
raws=[t.encode() for t in tests]
raws.append(b'{"services":["\xff"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}')  # invalid utf8 -> E_JSON
raws.append(b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r')  # trailing CR -> ok
payload=b'\n'.join(raws)+b'\n'
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=payload,capture_output=True)
